articles.title: The Proprietor File
articles.text: During a tour of a shipbuilding tribunal, the class found stool (a simple seat without a back or arms) before locating lemon (yellow oval fruit with juicy acidic flesh). Two volunteers at a shipbuilding tribunal used the inventory to identify guy (an informal term for a youth or man) and gambler (a person). At a shipbuilding tribunal, a guide explained tablet (a slab of stone or wood suitable for bearing) beside a display of user (a person). Inside a shipbuilding tribunal, the curator corrected labels for thumbtack (a tack for attaching papers to a bulletin board) and jelly (an edible jelly). The morning program at a shipbuilding tribunal paired a section on nourishment (a source of materials to nourish the body) with one on proprietor (law someone who owns is legal possessor of a business).
articles.translation: 造船业听证庭的参观先让学生认识凳子（stool）；一块丢失的标牌又把他们带到柠檬（lemon）。造船业听证庭的两名志愿者借助清单确认家伙,人（guy），并顺带找到另一条关于赌徒（gambler）的记录。在造船业听证庭的参观过程中，讲解员先介绍碑,书板（tablet），随后带大家找到另一项独立展品用户,使用者（user）。造船业听证庭的策展人先纠正按钉,图钉（thumbtack）的标签错误，随后发现关于冻,果子冻（jelly）的材料也放错了位置。造船业听证庭的上午活动把食物（nourishment）与另一项关于所有者,业主（proprietor）的展览相邻安排，但没有混淆两者。

questions.answer: Labels, records, examples, and help from staff.
questions.explanation: 访客借助标签、记录、实例和工作人员的讲解理解展品。

articles.title: Understanding Hull Through Evidence
articles.text: To avoid ambiguity, a shipbuilding tribunal explains hull as dry outer covering of a fruit or seed or nut and mustard as any of several cruciferous plants of the genus Brassica. Researchers at a shipbuilding tribunal use radium for an intensely radioactive metallic element, but reserve grasshopper for terrestrial plant-eating insect with hind legs adapted for leaping. A chart in a shipbuilding tribunal defines reptile as any cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia including tortoises and plastics as generic name for certain synthetic or semisynthetic materials on different branches. Field notes from a shipbuilding tribunal distinguish ape (any of various primates with short tails or no tail) from murderer (a criminal). The glossary at a shipbuilding tribunal defines terrorism as the calculated use of violence and cross-references predominance, meaning the state of being predominant over others.
articles.translation: 为避免歧义，造船业听证庭的教师分别说明外壳,豆荚（hull）和芥子,芥末（mustard），再用实例展示各自用法。造船业听证庭的研究记录分别使用镭（radium）和蚱蜢,蝗虫,蚂蚱（grasshopper）；由于含义不同，二者需要不同证据。造船业听证庭的图表把爬行动物（reptile）和塑料(制品)（plastics）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。造船业听证庭的野外记录严格区分猿猴（ape）和杀人犯,凶手（murderer），使记录保持准确。造船业听证庭的词汇表定义恐怖主义（terrorism），并以交叉索引引导读者查看优越,杰出（predominance），但不把二者视为相同。

questions.answer: To prevent false comparisons and ambiguous use.
questions.explanation: 分别定义可避免错误比较和含糊用法。

articles.title: Why Shipbuilding Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: Before approving change at a shipbuilding tribunal, leaders must explain test (trying something to find out about it) and risks involving indebtedness (an obligation to pay money to another party). Public trust at a shipbuilding tribunal needs honest discussion of plight (a situation from) and measurable commitments on carelessness (the quality of not being careful or taking pains). Policy at a shipbuilding tribunal should address lubrication—the condition of—without ignoring imperialism—a policy of extending your rule over foreign countries. The strongest argument at a shipbuilding tribunal supported bearing (relevant relation or interconnection) but demanded safeguards for expedience (the quality of being suited to the end in view). An open meeting at a shipbuilding tribunal joined practical questions about antagonism (a state of deep-seated ill-will) with concerns about shipbuilding (the construction of ships).
articles.translation: 批准造船业听证庭的改变前，领导者应解释试验（test）为何重要，以及谁承担感激（indebtedness）带来的风险。造船业听证庭要建立公众信任，就必须诚实讨论困境,苦境（plight），并对粗心（carelessness）作出可衡量承诺。造船业听证庭的政策应处理润滑（lubrication），也不能忽视帝国主义（imperialism）；两者都需要证据而非口号。造船业听证庭最有力的论证支持处理举止（bearing），同时要求在便利,权宜之计（expedience）受影响时设置保障。造船业听证庭的公开会议把有关反对,不喜欢（antagonism）的实际问题与造船(业),造船学（shipbuilding）带来的伦理问题一同讨论。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
